_about: DEMO facility list (B9). Names, addresses, coordinates and phone numbers were taken from the public sources named in each entry on 24 Nov 2026. NOTHING has been phone-verified by the team yet, so every service field (open 24h, emergency 24h, CT, BP check) is 'unknown' and the app shows 'Please call first'. Coordinates marked approximate are city-level or nearby-landmark positions. Add 10-20 entries (including health centres and pharmacies for BP checks) after verification calls [VERIFY].
